item_groups.name: Grow 18 SKUs with proven headroom
item_groups.detail: Hero and Traffic-Driver SKUs holding sell-through above 92% with three straight weeks of stockout hours. Deeper buys plus wider channel ranging.

item_groups.detail: Keep them ranged but cut buy depth to 4 weeks of cover. No channel delisting, so no revenue cliff — capital comes back as the current cover burns down.

item_groups.name: Exit 12 Exit-Candidate SKUs
item_groups.detail: Two consecutive quarters below the GMROI floor, none carrying a brand or contract lock. Stop-buy immediately, clear remaining units through markdown.

item_groups.name: Range the top 4 whitespace gap fills
item_groups.detail: Ranged by three or more rivals, absent from your set, high demand overlap with the Hero cohort. Test quantities only — full buy after a 60-day read.
